Name: New NPC Lorence 1.6 - English
Author: sakialyn
Description:
Please note, this is just the i18n file for the English translation. You will still need to download the 1.6 updated mod from here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28309]New NPC Lorence 1.6

[/url]I'm a native English speaker and unfortunately do not know any Chinese. Because of this, I had to rely on Google for the initial translation before then going over each line to make sure the sentences sounded coherent.

Credit to the original creator of this NPC, Chiko/lansefeng - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7509]New NPC Lorence[/url]
Credit to muxuelaiyin for updating this NPC to 1.6 and converting it to i18n format - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28309]New NPC Lorence 1.6[/url]

Downloads.Description: Download and put into Lorence's i18n folder
